arguments.sql:
SELECT sat.rtype, s.State, s.Virtual, typeof(sat.AvgScrMath) AS score_type, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(s.School) AS named_schools
FROM main.satscores AS sat
LEFT JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 400
GROUP BY sat.rtype, s.State, s.Virtual, typeof(sat.AvgScrMath)

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1
) AS virtual_instruction_pct
FROM main.schools AS s
JOIN main.satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND sat.rtype = 'S'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400
LIMIT 1
